summary.limits: Authored exposed development requests; target rank is not complete semantic recall, actual managed material sampling, native source qualification, source adoption, saved pixels, causal quality gain or requester acceptance.
summary.interpretation: All twenty targets are newly introduced CIDs absent from the baseline by construction. Their ranks show successor exposure for authored, research-exposed requests, not improvement in semantic recall or generated-image quality. No baseline semantic-equivalence labeling was performed.
summary.ordinary_control_observation: One of six ordinary controls exposed the new evening-dress visual source in its top ten; the control itself requested an evening dress. This is compatible optional garment material, not evidence of investigative-scene contamination or automatic adoption. The other five controls exposed none of the new positive records in their top ten.
